title: Prospective enlarged arithmetic isogeny pilot v2
proposition: Test a fixed ACSC-like versus modified MCJ arithmetic distance contrast over every eligible conductor from a SHA-pinned 64,687-row ecdata source using rank-conditioned shuffles.
falsifier: Conditional null produces equally or more extreme statistic, invariant identities fail, or effects are unstable under predeclared coordinate scaling.
